summary: OpenAI published version 0.0.9 of the gpt-oss open-weights repository, containing bug fixes, Metal/CPU-GPU sync optimizations for the reference inference implementation, a reinforcement fine-tuning example, and minor documentation updates.

practices.reason: Removing unnecessary GPU-CPU synchronization and KV-cache copy steps during prefill reduces overhead in the reference gpt-oss inference stack, but no quantified latency or throughput gain is given.
practices.quote: Removing GPU-CPU sync during MoE MLP in Prefill by @ibahmed-oai in https://github.com/openai/gpt-oss/pull/218

practices.reason: Minor code-level changes (header tracking, Metal type check simplification) create negligible integration work for teams using the repo.
practices.quote: Add user-agent to headers for tracking by @smboy in https://github.com/openai/gpt-oss/pull/235
